description: Defines classes, structures, and constants related to HTTP network sessions in Chromium, including session parameters, context, and management of socket pools, SPDY, and QUIC sessions.

classes.name: HttpNetworkSessionParams
classes.description: Holds configuration options for an HTTP network session, including protocol settings, QUIC options, and connection behaviors.

classes.name: HttpNetworkSessionContext
classes.description: Contains pointers to dependencies required by HttpNetworkSession, such as socket factories, resolvers, and security components.

classes.name: HttpNetworkSession
classes.description: Manages HTTP network sessions, including socket pools, SPDY/HTTP2/QUIC sessions, and connection management.

methods.name: HttpNetworkSessionParams()
methods.description: Constructor for HttpNetworkSessionParams.

methods.name: HttpNetworkSessionParams(const HttpNetworkSessionParams&)
methods.description: Copy constructor for HttpNetworkSessionParams.

methods.name: ~HttpNetworkSessionParams()
methods.description: Destructor for HttpNetworkSessionParams.

methods.name: HttpNetworkSession(const HttpNetworkSessionParams&, const HttpNetworkSessionContext&)
methods.description: Constructor for HttpNetworkSession, initializes session with parameters and context.

methods.name: ~HttpNetworkSession()
methods.description: Destructor for HttpNetworkSession.

methods.name: HttpAuthCache* http_auth_cache()
methods.description: Returns pointer to the HTTP authentication cache.

methods.name: SSLClientContext* ssl_client_context()
methods.description: Returns pointer to the SSL client context.

methods.name: void StartResponseDrainer(std::unique_ptr<HttpResponseBodyDrainer>)
methods.description: Starts a response drainer.

methods.name: void RemoveResponseDrainer(HttpResponseBodyDrainer*)
methods.description: Removes a response drainer.

methods.name: ClientSocketPool* GetSocketPool(SocketPoolType, const ProxyServer&)
methods.description: Retrieves socket pool for specified type and proxy.

methods.name: void CloseAllConnections(int, const char*)
methods.description: Closes all active connections with specified error and log reason.

methods.name: void CloseIdleConnections(const char*)
methods.description: Closes idle connections with specified log reason.

methods.name: bool IsQuicEnabled() const
methods.description: Checks if QUIC is enabled for new streams.

methods.name: void DisableQuic()
methods.description: Disables QUIC for new streams.

methods.name: void SetEnableQuic(bool)
methods.description: Enables or disables QUIC (conditional on Cobalt customizations).

methods.name: void SetEnableHttp2(bool)
methods.description: Enables or disables HTTP/2 (conditional on Cobalt customizations).

methods.name: bool UseQuicForUnknownOrigin() const
methods.description: Determines whether to use QUIC for origins without alt-svc info (conditional on Cobalt).

methods.name: void ClearSSLSessionCache()
methods.description: Clears the SSL session cache.

methods.name: CommonConnectJobParams CreateCommonConnectJobParams(bool)
methods.description: Creates connection parameters for network jobs.

methods.name: void SetConnectionOptions(const quic::QuicTagVector&)
methods.description: Sets QUIC connection options (conditional on Cobalt).

methods.name: void SetClientConnectionOptions(const quic::QuicTagVector&)
methods.description: Sets client-side QUIC connection options (conditional on Cobalt).
